run_create_uma_finetune_dataset_cli: run the CLI script to process ASE atoms directories and generate YAML configs for UMA model fine-tuning
create_yaml_finetune_configs: create YAML data task and fine-tune template configs from training and validation dataset paths
launch_processing_ase_atoms: launch parallel processing to convert ASE atoms object directories into a format ready for model training
compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference: compute the force RMS normalizer and linear reference coefficients from processed training data
review_create_yaml_function: review the create_yaml function that populates dataset name, normalizer RMSD, and element references into YAML templates
